overview_description.description:
Panels is a widget provider for blogs that helps link to relevant third-party information about a mentioned institution or organization, aggregating that information and links in a single panel on the blog site.  

Aggregated information made available in a company's "panel" includes links, projects, job listings, management, and reviews, among other info.
